title: Toy building brick
abstract: A hollow building block of rectangular shape with primary cylindrical projections extending outward and secondary tubular projections extending inward from the cavity floor. The secondary projections are positioned at the center of squares defined by four primary projections, enabling coupling between blocks in multiple orientations through friction-based clamping.
gist: The LEGO stud-and-tube brick: hollow bricks with studs on top and tubes underneath positioned so that studs are clamped by friction, giving a firm but releasable connection in many orientations.
